steps.text: Interact sits immediately and sends seat.sit with the nearest reachable alternatives. A queued request is prediction, not confirmation.

The server keeps one chair per player, never displaces a sitter, and grants the first free chair in request order. Every tab mirrors the same transient seat rows; a loser slides to a free neighbour or steps off if all are taken. A rate refusal holds the prediction and retries.

Movement remains Owner-driven in the platform frame. The server row and Owner presence must both name a friend's chair before it draws their seated pose. Jump or Interact stands immediately; reconnects re-claim with alternatives once a second. Seats are never saved.
